description: Notification bell icon button backed by ITmNotificationService. It shows unread count, loads recipient notifications on demand, supports unread filtering, and marks individual or all notifications as read through the shared service. The panel stays the anchored popover at every width unless the host opts into the shared mobile bottom sheet through MobilePresentation.

parameters.name: CurrentUserId
parameters.description: Recipient user id used when querying ITmNotificationService.

parameters.name: OnDropdownOpenChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the notification dropdown opens or closes.

parameters.name: MobilePresentation
parameters.description: How the notification panel presents on a narrow viewport. Default Popover: the anchored popover at every width. Auto opts into the shared content-height bottom sheet on a mobile viewport (the anchored popover otherwise). A forced value renders that presentation without measuring (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: SheetTitle
parameters.description: Title of the sheet header when the panel presents as a bottom sheet. When null (default), the localized TmNotificationBell_SheetTitle default is used. Has no effect on the popover presentation, which stays named by the visible in-panel title (since 2.9.1).

parameters.name: AdditionalAttributes
parameters.description: Additional attributes splatted onto the root element.
